title: OKEAN Recognized As Ferretti Yachts' Top Dealer Globally
description: OKEAN Group receives top dealer and market recognition from Ferretti Group during Monaco conference, marking six years of exclusive production.
html:
Brazilian Shipyard Earns Prestigious Award At Global Dealers Meeting 2026

The OKEAN Group has been recognized as the best dealer and best market for Ferretti Yachts worldwide, a distinction announced during the Global Dealers Meeting 2026 held in Monaco. This achievement marks a significant milestone for the Brazilian shipyard, which has spent six years building and representing Ferretti Yachts exclusively in the country. The recognition underscores the strength of the partnership between the Italian luxury yacht manufacturer and the OKEAN Group, positioning Brazil as a key market within Ferretti Group's global strategy.

The award ceremony highlighted several accomplishments that contributed to OKEAN's success. During the past year, the OKEAN Shipyard completed the construction and delivery of two Ferretti Yachts 1000 models, a milestone that Ferretti Group specifically recognized during the ceremony. Beyond these flagship vessels, OKEAN has maintained steady production of multiple Ferretti Yachts models including the 550, 670, 720, and 850, all currently in the Brazilian production line. Roberto Paião, CEO of the OKEAN Group, expressed gratitude for the recognition, crediting the achievement to the collective effort of the team, commercial partners, and clients who have supported the company's mission.

The journey that began in 2020 has evolved into a partnership that now places Brazil prominently on the world stage of luxury maritime commerce. The recognition at the Global Dealers Meeting 2026 represents not merely a celebration of past accomplishments but a new starting point for future growth. OKEAN's position as the top-performing dealer globally reflects the quality of construction, customer service, and market understanding that the shipyard has cultivated over six years of dedicated work. The partnership between OKEAN and Ferretti Group continues to strengthen, with the Brazilian market proving itself as a vital component of the Italian manufacturer's international expansion strategy.

Looking forward, OKEAN Group remains committed to navigating new chapters of success alongside Ferretti Group. The award validates the company's approach to luxury yacht production and distribution in Brazil, while also signaling confidence in the market's continued growth. With this recognition secured, OKEAN is positioned to pursue even greater achievements, building on the foundation established over the past six years and exploring new opportunities within the luxury maritime sector. The future holds promise for continued collaboration, innovation, and expansion as the partnership between OKEAN and Ferretti Group charts its course toward new horizons in the global yacht market.
